messages:
maria: FYI SFO GPU pool just degraded — autoscaler failing to attach new nodes, currently ~60% capacity vs expected. Seeing increased queueing for short-lived gen requests. :rotating_light:
jon: can you paste the quick impact numbers? p95 latency / error rate / queue length?
maria: p95 token latency up from 220ms -> 380ms for small gens, error rate on low-priority routes 4.7%, queue depth `gpu-async-queue` ~230, filling mostly with embed jobs.
sre-shift: creating incident and paging oncall now. tagging for traffic steering.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2105 created by sre-shift — severity: high. Bridge: https://rdw.inc/bridges/INC-2105 — responders: @eng-oncall @maria @akash.
akash: I see provisioning stuck in the sfo-provisioner logs; nodes stuck in PROVISIONING_WAIT with agent failing to bootstrap. grabbing logs, will try forced restart of provisioner.
akash: log snippet: ```ProvisionerError: failed to mount nvme -> timeout mounting /dev/nvme0n1 (rc=30)
Traceback (most recent call last): ProvisionerTimeoutError```
jon: can we triage at routing layer to reduce customer impact? prefer steering to us-west2 & eu-west1 capacity rather than spinning burst GPUs.
maria: agree. akash, can you open a dynamic routing rule to shift 35% of SFO traffic to us-west2 and 25% to eu-west1, rest stays on degraded sfo for sticky sessions.
akash: applying runbook command now: ```rdwctl route update --from sfo --distribution us-west2=0.35,eu-west1=0.25,sfo=0.40 --priority emergency-reshuffle```
akash: command applied, verifying. observing immediate drop in queue depth to ~120.
customer-success: need an ETA for external comms and recommended messaging for customers with Dedicated capacity. We have a few enterprise escalations open.
maria: drafting status page and support reply. ETA for full recovery currently unknown — provisioner restart attempt in progress, if that fails fallback is to reprovision pools in sfo which is ~2-4 hours. Initial customer notice: "We are experiencing reduced GPU capacity in SFO causing increased latency for some workloads. We are steering traffic to adjacent regions and working on provisioning. Next update in 30 minutes."
eng-oncall: raising cost note — steering increases cross-region egress & peak provisioned units; finance might want to know if we should enable spot burst.
finance: if we enable burst spot GPUs expect 3x short-term cost for the affected hour(s). approve only if customer SLA at risk.
maria: noted. we will keep spot burst as plan B if routing + reprovision doesn't bring latency under p95 300ms.
sre-shift: status page draft posted to #incidents-updates for review. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2105-draft
customer-success: sending provisional note to top 5 escalations now, will include ETA and mention fallback routing.
akash: provisioner restart completed, currently waiting for node bootstraps. delta: 12 nodes moved to ACTIVE in last 6m.
maria: good sign — queue down to 60, low-priority errors falling to 1.2%. keeping traffic distribution for 20 mins and monitoring.
eng-oncall: if health stabilizes, we'll rollback routing in controlled stages. schedule rollback at 2105023200 if metrics hold.
maria: thanks everyone. next update when we either hit steady-state or hit the 2h mark.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2105 status changed to under_recovery.
